fields.acceptance_criteria: an explicit pre-create gate step exists in the workflow requiring a search of the target store before any entity creation; the gate requires creation to be justified against search results rather than assumed; agent templates with entity-creation grants carry the gate and read-only roles do not; the gate fires when a sub-agent is dispatched following a ticket-track review; the default framing is delta-against-current-state for tickets specs and other entities; no server-side fuzzy duplicate-title warning is added
fields.title: [agent-workflow] Add an explicit pre-create entity gate so agents apply deltas instead of duplicating tickets and specs
